name: toggle-button
title: ToggleButton
description: Fluent 2's ToggleButton on Base UI's Toggle: a Button that stays checked, in Button's primary, secondary, outline, subtle and transparent appearances and small, medium and large.
usage: Use ToggleButton for a setting that is on or off and takes effect at once, in a toolbar or next to what it changes: word wrap in an editor, "show nulls" over a grid. Subtle is the default (toolbars); secondary or outline where it stands beside inputs. Pass its Icon `filled` while pressed, as Fluent does. Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label naming the setting ("Word wrap"), not the action; the pressed state is announced. For one choice out of several, or several related toggles, use ToggleGroup; for a setting in a form, use Switch or Checkbox. The old variant prop (ghost is subtle) and sm/md/lg still work for one release.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called when the user presses or releases the toggle.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Button's appearances; checked adds the selected wash (the accent's pressed solid on primary, accent text on transparent).

props.name: size
props.description: Button's sizes: size.control.sm, md, lg (24, 32, 40 px comfortable; 22, 28, 34 compact).

props.name: variant
props.description: The old name of appearance; ghost maps to subtle. Kept for one release.

props.name: size (sm, md, lg)
props.description: The old size names, mapped to small, medium and large. Kept for one release.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of an icon-only toggle: the setting it turns on.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element with the toggle's props (state.pressed swaps an icon).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The toggle; data-slot="toggle-button", data-appearance, data-size and data-pressed name it.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An optional child Icon, sized by the size (16, 20, 24 px); filled while pressed.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over it: the appearance's hover look.

states.name: active
states.description: While pressing: the appearance's pressed look.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Checked: color.interactive.selected (the accent's pressed solid on primary, accent text on transparent), aria-pressed="true".

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: Fluent's double ring (@/lib/control focusRing).

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction: Fluent's disabled fill and text.

accessibility: Renders a native <button> with aria-pressed, so Enter and Space toggle it and screen readers announce "toggle button, pressed".
Icon-only toggles need an aria-label naming the setting ("Word wrap"); keep the name the same in both states, the pressed state carries the change.
Pressed is shown by a change of fill (color.interactive.selected, or the accent's pressed solid) and of text colour, and announced by aria-pressed, not by colour alone.
Focus shows Fluent's double ring: an outline in color.ring (kept in forced-colours mode, 3:1 on every surface) around color.ring-inner.
